book.name: Ola Saam
book.title: Ola Saam Ola Song En Preya Langa God

content: Wen wi onap blanga wi nogudbalawei, God im sori langa wi
Deibid bin onap langa God blanga im nogudbalawei en God bin larramgo im fri.

content.text: Ol detlot pipul weya YAWEI det trubala God bin larramgo fri brom ola nogudbala ting weya deibin dumbat,
olabat garra jidan brabli gudbinji.
YAWEI kaan neba bukumdan ol detlot nogudbala ting blanga olabat.
Im kaan jinggabat ol detlot ting blanga detlot hu jinggabat ebrijing trubalawei.
Olabat garra brabli gudbinji.
YAWEI, dumaji ai nomo bin dalim yu blanga ol main nogudbalawei,
wal main bodi bin brabli nogud,
en aibin abum detmatj pein aibin jinginat.
Yubin kipgon panishimbat mi lagijat ebridei en ebrinait.
Jis laik detlot gras weya draiyap en go wikwan langa hotwethataim,
wal lagijat du aibin abum pein detmatj en aibin brabli wikwan.
Aibin tok miselp, “Ai garra dalim YAWEI blanga ola nogudbala ting aibin dumbat.”
En aibin dalim yu blanga ol main nogud ting.
Ai nomo bin blandim eni nogud ting brom yu.
En yubin larramgo mi fri blanga ol detlot nogud ting weya ai nomo bin bulurrum yu lowa.
Wal ola pipul hu oldei bulurrum yu brabliwei,
dei garra prei langa yu langa det taim wen olabat jidan langa detmatj trabul.
Det trabul im laik fladwoda weya nokamdanbat en deigidaweibat ebrijing,
bat im kaan gajimap ola pipul blanga God.
Yu blandim mi langa seifwan pleis.
Yu garra lukaftum mi wen trabul kaman.
Yu seibum mi en ai garra sing en preisim yu,
en ola najalot pipul garra jingat gudbinjiwei dumaji yubin seibum mi.
YAWEI tok langa wi,
“Ai garra titjim yu.
Ai garra dalim yu det raitwei blanga go.
Ai garra wotjimbat yu en ai garra dalim yu.
Nomo jidan laik det hos en det dongki.
Dei nomo sabi en teiknodis wen yu tok langa olabat.
Yu garra pudumon det braidul en bit blanga meigim olabat dum wanim yu wandim.
Nomo jidan laik detlot enimul,
bat yu teiknodis wen ai tok.”
Detlot nogudbala pipul garra abum brabli adtaim,
bat YAWEI im oldei kipgon laigimbat detlot pipul hu trastim im.
Yumob pipul hu bulurrum YAWEI,
wi garra gudbinji garram im.
Ol wi pipul hu gudbinji blanga bulurrum im,
wi garra jinginat dumaji wi hepi.
